card: Updates doc/i2p.md to clarify that persistent addresses are not used for all outbound connections when -privatebroadcast is set, as that option creates transient destinations for transaction relay. It fixes an omission in the documentation that could mislead node operators about how I2P addresses and identity persistence function under private broadcast settings. The change is documentation-only with no code modifications.
evidence: PR description: "It is not entirely accurate that persistent I2P addresses are used for making outbound connections and accepting incoming ones, as the -privatebroadcast option forces the use of a new transient destination for each transaction it relays."
problem: The I2P documentation inaccurately implies persistent addresses are always used for inbound and outbound connections, omitting how -privatebroadcast alters destination handling during transaction broadcast.

risk.why: A typo or error in documentation would at worst confuse node operators configuring I2P.

summary: Updates the I2P documentation to clarify that persistent I2P addresses are not used for all outbound traffic. It notes that the -privatebroadcast option bypasses the persistent address by using transient destinations when relaying transactions.
